doubts.claim_under_doubt: a moved criterion number can never be minted again
doubts.disproof_attempt: The AC registry was never updated, so after moving the highest numbers the minter could re-issue FR-01.11/AC48 while the move map also sends AC48 elsewhere.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: RESOLVED: fr_split writes the pre-cut high-water mark of the source and the new FRs into shipwright_ac_registry.json (test added).

doubts.disproof_attempt: The push-time baseline-growth check would read FR-01.22/AC12 as a new grandfathered entry and turn main red.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: RESOLVED: baseline_grown_since_parent maps the parent set through the AC-Move-Map (test added).

doubts.disproof_attempt: A manifest-restore failure skipped the file restore and still printed all files restored.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: RESOLVED: restore whenever anything failed, honest message, created files removed again.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: apply is safe in a working tree with other edits
doubts.disproof_attempt: Targets were overwritten with plan-time bytes after a long regeneration.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: RESOLVED: bytes re-compared before writing, uncommitted targets refuse (--allow-dirty), originals backed up to a temp dir.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the dry run equals what apply will accept
doubts.disproof_attempt: The evidence walker skips some directories and files over 2 MB that the manifest collector reads.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: ACCEPTED: apply still refuses and restores; documented in the iterate spec.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: move-map rows do not disturb tests
doubts.disproof_attempt: Tests counting lines that start with | FR- would count map rows.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: RESOLVED: ids are written in backticks.

doubts.disproof_attempt: No consumer reads the move map except the baseline-growth check.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: ACCEPTED: follow-up, listed in the iterate spec.

doubts.disproof_attempt: A parametrize row mentioning covers would be rewritten.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: RESOLVED: only covers(...) calls are rewritten (test added).
